# `state_actions`

State regulatory actions, one row per action. An action is a state rulemaking (the state counterpart of a regulations.gov docket) and moves through stages listed in `state_stages`. Virginia only so far, crawled from the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall (townhall.virginia.gov), back to 1999. The crawl is resumable: until the first backfill finishes, older actions are still missing. Sorted by `jurisdiction`, then `action_id` descending. Built by `build_va_townhall`.

- **Parquet file:** `state_actions.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | `VARCHAR` | USPS code of the state (`VA`). Part of the key, so later states can share the table. |
| `action_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall action ID. Unique within `jurisdiction`; joins `state_stages.action_id`. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Action title as the agency named it. |
| `summary` | `VARCHAR` | The agency's summary of the action. |
| `agency` | `VARCHAR` | Agency that owns the regulation, e.g. `Department of Health Professions`. |
| `agency_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall agency number. |
| `board` | `VARCHAR` | Board or other body that adopts the regulation, e.g. `Board of Psychology`. Often the same as `agency`. |
| `board_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall board ID. |
| `chapter_citation` | `VARCHAR` | Virginia Administrative Code chapter the action amends, normalized from Town Hall's `[18 VAC 125 ‑ 20]` to `18VAC125-20`. It is the chapter prefix of the section citations in `state_program_approvals.state_citations_json` (`9VAC5-10-20` is in `9VAC5-10`), so the two join with `starts_with`. |
| `chapter_title` | `VARCHAR` | Title of that chapter. |
| `chapter_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall chapter ID. |
| `chapters_affected` | `VARCHAR` | Town Hall's note on other chapters the action touches, e.g. `Only affects this chapter.` |
| `withdrawn_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the action was withdrawn (YYYY-MM-DD); NULL if it was not. |
| `stage_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of the action's stage IDs, oldest first, as the action page lists them. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | Town Hall page for the action. |
| `fetched_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time this row was last fetched (ISO 8601). |
